p.title: v59.97 stopping an AI answer removes the 분석 중 bubble and the streaming caret
p.symptom: After pressing stop in the AI panel, the '분석 중...' bubble and the blinking caret stayed on screen.
p.root_cause: _aioCancelChatRequest looked for the retired per-page classes (.acp-msg wrapper, .chat-cursor caret); the unified panel builds .ai-msg bubbles that carry the loading id themselves and a .lch-caret caret.
p.fix: Cancel removes loading.closest('.ai-msg, .acp-msg') or the loading element itself, and removes carets of both kinds (.lch-caret, .chat-cursor).
p.violated_rule: A cancelled request leaves no pending animation on screen.
p.prevention: ci-ai-chat-reliability-contract-check chat-resilience cancels a unified run with stub elements; ci-chat-ui-state-browser-check cancels a run over the panel's real markup in Chromium and checks no #ai-panel-loading, no .lch-caret, the partial answer kept and one stop notice.
p.verification: Both gates pass; both fail on the old _aioCancelChatRequest.

changelog: **Stop clears the AI panel ({P}):** stopping an answer now removes the '분석 중' bubble and the streaming caret of the current panel instead of looking for retired class names.
note: v59.97: stop clears loading bubble and caret
